reviews.title: It’s a great fast tracker
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Fasty has been a great app for keeping track of my fasting habits. It’s simple, intuitive, and makes it easy to see how long I’ve been fasting and stay consistent with my routine. I especially like being able to monitor my progress over time—it gives me that extra motivation to stick with my goals. No unnecessary complications, just a clean and useful tool that helps keep me accountable. Definitely recommend Fasty to anyone practicing intermittent fasting!

reviews.title: They have thought of everything
reviews.text:
I’ve been using the free version of this app for over a year now. I am more than satisfied with the features included in the free version.

Editing my start/end times, viewing my fasting history in the statistics section, and tracking my weight via Apple Health are my favorites.

I also really like how the app shows what stage of the fast I am in and includes a nice explanation of what’s happening with my body during each stage.

I don’t pay much attention to the preset goals. Although, I’m sure it’s nice for people who like to explore different fasting goals.

The free version is enough for me but I may upgrade to pro to show my appreciation to the developer for building such a beautiful app.
